title: NIST/CODATA 2022 hydrogen c-boundary calibration

derived_hydrogen_anchor.identity: K = r_e within the supplied CODATA constants

scope: NIST identifies alpha with v1/c for the first circular Bohr orbit. K is the derived hydrogen c-boundary alpha^2 a0 = r_e = r_S/2 in the SDT convention, not a separately measured trajectory. Nuclear radius entries are rms charge radii and are not hard nuclear surfaces.
